{{Top|leg}}
The '''THR-4B thruster component''' was produced by [[Celestial Industries]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] thrusters, it increased maximum engine power by heightening thruster efficiency.
